note: This extension is configured by editing the SYSTEM_PROMPT constant in the extension file. No external config file approach.

SYSTEM_PROMPT.purpose: Instructions for the LLM on how to generate handoff prompts
current_focus: Clearly state next task based on user goal

code_focused_summary.description: Use this if you want code-heavy summaries
modify_SYSTEM_PROMPT_to_focus_on: All code files modified or discussed
Specific code patterns or gotchas discovered

requirement_focused_summary.description: Use this if you want requirement-heavy summaries

how_to_customize.step_3: Replace the prompt text with your custom instructions

examples: /handoff now implement this for teams as well
/handoff execute phase one of the plan
/handoff check other places that need this fix

workflow.step_2: Extension extracts conversation history from current branch
workflow.step_3: LLM generates focused prompt using SYSTEM_PROMPT
workflow.step_4: User sees generated prompt in editor and can edit
workflow.step_5: User can accept (by sending) or modify before sending
workflow.step_6: New session created with parent session reference

features.parent_session_tracking: New session records which session it came from
features.compaction_aware: If conversation was compacted, handoff includes compaction summary
features.model_respects_current: Uses whatever model is selected (respects /model setting)
features.editor_review: User can edit generated prompt before sending to new session

if_you_want_specific_model_for_summariza.to_change: Edit the model selection logic to hardcode a specific model
